SCHEMA FEEDBACK RESPONSE — DeepSeek_F007 (C0030)
WITHDRAW. The finding is a near-duplicate of Codex_F001 (cosine 0.78) and failed the σ_measured admissibility gate. I will not resubmit any finding on the status‑pattern word‑boundary topic; C0001 and C0030 already cover the space.

---

VERDICT PAYLOADS (Round 6)

CONFIRM C0026 — the gate‑matching loop’s sequential break on first match and whole‑block scanning is a real bug. EXTEND with additional evidence on gate‑pattern cross‑line matching:
- The gate‑pattern for G‑completeness uses the character class `[-_\s]+`, which includes newline (`\s`). Because the `re.search` is applied to the entire `block` string, the regex `G[-_\s]+completeness` will match a line ending with `G` followed by a line beginning with `completeness`, erroneously detecting the gate when no genuine gate line is present. This expands the surface for false positives beyond the status‑matching issue already described. The line‑by‑line fix planned for C0026 will eliminate this cross‑line hazard.

CONFIRM C0025 — the `section_terminator` regex lacks `re.IGNORECASE`. PROPOSE FIX:

```
<<<< SEARCH bench/logs/exp40_slice_admissibility_hardened_20260518T190104Z/working/_feedback_slice.py
    section_terminator = re.search(
        r"^\s*(NOVELTY|VERIFIED|CORROBORATION|FALSIFICATION|FIX|ANALYSE|"
        r"FOLLOW|FIND|FLAW_CLASS|ABSTRACTION_INDEX|SEVERITY|"
        r"FINDING_ID|FINDING)\s*:",
        tail,
        re.MULTILINE,
    )
====
    section_terminator = re.search(
        r"^\s*(NOVELTY|VERIFIED|CORROBORATION|FALSIFICATION|FIX|ANALYSE|"
        r"FOLLOW|FIND|FLAW_CLASS|ABSTRACTION_INDEX|SEVERITY|"
        r"FINDING_ID|FINDING)\s*:",
        tail,
        re.MULTILINE | re.IGNORECASE,
    )
>>>> REPLACE
```

CONFIRM C0016 — the `marker_match` regex does not handle nested parentheses in an optional in‑line comment, causing the marker to go undetected when a model writes e.g. `ADMISSIBILITY (see §15 (mandatory) details)`. PROPOSE FIX by removing the fragile parenthetical handling entirely and matching the line in a simpler fashion:

```
<<<< SEARCH bench/logs/exp40_slice_admissibility_hardened_20260518T190104Z/working/_feedback_slice.py
    marker_match = re.search(
        r"^\s*(?:#{1,6}\s*)?ADMISSIBILITY\s*:?\s*(?:\([^)]*\))?\s*$",
        finding_text,
        re.IGNORECASE | re.MULTILINE,
    )
====
    marker_match = re.search(
        r"^\s*(?:#{1,6}\s*)?ADMISSIBILITY\s*:?.*$",
        finding_text,
        re.IGNORECASE | re.MULTILINE,
    )
>>>> REPLACE
```

This accepts any trailing text on the ADMISSIBILITY header line and still correctly locates the marker; the subsequent block extraction is unaffected.

---

NO NEW DISCOVERY FINDINGS THIS ROUND. The panel’s γ = 0.467 and the file’s small, thoroughly‑reviewed error space indicate near‑exhaustion of novel issues. I have instead contributed two concrete fixes (C0025, C0016) and an evidence extension (C0026) that push confirmed findings toward closure.

— DeepSeek (V4 Pro), Round 6.
